items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall officially inactive today after being unlikely to play while returning from quad strain.
items.why: Hasn't been full participant; early in return from three-game absence.
items.implication: Jets RB committee or backup lead; major fantasy scratch.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/carries to other Jets RBs.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Week 7 vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley expected to start. Confirmed in ETR Sunday morning summary after Saturday downgrade.
items.why: Ankle injury; close but downgraded overnight/Saturday.
items.implication: Ravens offense downgrade; Huntley start impacts all skill players.
items.opportunity: Reduced QB rushing/ dual-threat; potential volume shift to RBs/WRs under Huntley.

items.text: Texans WR Tank Dell activated and ACTIVE for first NFL action in nearly two years; officially active today.
items.implication: Potential target share in HOU WR room.

items.text: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield ACTIVE today with protective glove for dislocated thumb; returns after absence.
items.why: Thumb protected; returns first time since Sept 27.

items.text: Titans WR Calvin Ridley inactive today.
items.opportunity: Increased share for other Titans WRs.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY Monday vs Cowboys despite questionable (hamstring); ETR and Rapoport align.
items.why: Returned to practice; expected after hamstring absence.
items.implication: Lead back role if active vs favorable DAL matchup.
items.opportunity: Primary carries/snaps; DeVonta/Wicks OUT boosts pass game too.

items.text: Rams optimistic Puka Nacua (calf) will play vs Raiders; feeling better Saturday, no setbacks expected. ETR lists GTD/OPTIMISM.
items.why: Calf improved; sources confident if no setbacks.
items.implication: Likely WR1 usage if active; Adams already OUT.
items.opportunity: High target share in depleted Rams WR room.

items.text: Giants RB Cam Skattebo expected to resume lead back role vs Texans.
Eagles WR DeVonta Smith OUT (hamstring); Dontayvion Wicks also OUT. Saquon still expected.
items.implication: PHI pass catchers thinned; targets to remaining WRs/TE.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for other Eagles pass-catchers.

items.text: Packers activated Josh Jacobs; expected to play Sunday at Detroit after activation from exempt.
items.implication: Lead RB role likely but workload questions post-absence.
items.opportunity: Carries/goal-line vs DET; Berry notes caution.
items.conflict: Berry HATE due to layoff workload risk.

items.text: Lamar, Puka, Breece statuses crucial to Sunday DFS main slate; sneaky scratches include Brian Robinson, Tyler Warren, Emeka Egbuka. Projections updated on latest news.
items.why: Key DFS pivots on these; missed scratches important.
items.implication: Monitor closely for lineup/DFS pivots; beneficiaries from outs.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups behind outs like Egbuka/Warren/BRob.

items.text: Tempted to buy CMC lining up more in slot amid 49ers WR outs (Evans/Deebo OUT) despite usual skepticism of RB-as-WR claims; Kaelon Black presence noted.
items.why: Dire WR situation; CMC smile on question.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI for usage/matchup; Bears good for yardage.
items.why: Back in real role; favorable Bears matchup for yardage.

items.text: Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET; Lions TE buffet with 9 TE TDs allowed.
Loves Jaylen Warren @ NO for big workload in friendly matchup.
items.why: Volume vs defense carved by RBs.

items.text: Loves Chuba Hubbard vs TB for consistent volume in good spot.
Loves Bucky Irving @ CAR for volume vs soft RB defense.
Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET due to workload questions after long layoff.
